body.name: Tolerance-certified optimizer handle
body.construction: Use outward-rounded Gaussian tail integration, monotone critical-value brackets, derivative-based oscillation bounds, and adaptive box subdivision of the compact \((\rho,\theta)\)-domain to enclose \(V^{\star}\) and the near-optimal design sets; an optional separation certificate consists of isolating boxes, interval root uniqueness tests, exclusions on their complements, strict candidate-value comparisons, and a positive objective gap outside the winning boxes.
